# Cha Jewels Hub

> Customer portal for Cha Jewels layaway customers to view accounts, payment schedules, submit proof of payment, and access the loyalty program.

## Pages

- [Customer Portal](/portal): View layaway accounts, payment schedules, and statements.
- [Portal Login](/portal/login): Sign in to your customer account.
- [Portal Setup](/portal/setup): Create a new customer portal account.
- [Forgot Password](/portal/forgot-password): Reset your portal password.
- [Loyalty Program](/loyalty): View loyalty points, tier status, and rewards.
